description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to handling Xtensa architecture core dumps and GDB stub interactions for various SoCs and toolchains. It includes register mappings, exception codes, and methods for parsing architecture data blocks and generating GDB packets.

classes.name: GdbStub_Xtensa
classes.description: GDB stub implementation for Xtensa architecture, handling register parsing, exception signals, and packet responses.

classes.name: GdbRegDef_Sample_Controller
classes.description: Register mapping for Sample Controller SoC, specific to Zephyr SDK.

classes.name: GdbRegDef_ESP32
classes.description: Register mapping for ESP32 SoC, specific to Espressif toolchain.

classes.name: GdbRegDef_ESP32S2
classes.description: Register mapping for ESP32-S2 SoC, Espressif.

classes.name: GdbRegDef_ESP32S3
classes.description: Register mapping for ESP32-S3 SoC, Espressif.

classes.name: GdbRegDef_Intel_Adsp_CAVS_Zephyr
classes.description: Register mapping for Intel ADSP CAVS SoC, Zephyr SDK.

classes.name: GdbRegDef_Intel_Adsp_CAVS_XCC
classes.description: Register mapping for Intel ADSP CAVS SoC, Cadence XCC toolchain.

methods.name: get_gdb_reg_definition
methods.description: Returns the appropriate register definition class based on SoC and toolchain.

methods.name: parse_arch_data_block
methods.description: Parses architecture-specific data block to extract version, SoC, toolchain, and register values.

methods.name: map_registers
methods.description: Maps unpacked register data to internal register dictionary.

methods.name: compute_signal
methods.description: Determines GDB signal based on exception code.

methods.name: handle_register_group_read_packet
methods.description: Generates a GDB packet with register values for bulk read.

methods.name: handle_register_single_read_packet
methods.description: Generates a GDB packet for a single register read.
